name: Misty Citron
source:
Occupation: Maid
Hobbies: Making delicious coffee

Works as a maid in a mansion on the outskirts of town. Was originally an orphan till her current Master took her in and now she leads a very busy and fulfilling life.

To cure her Master's incurable illness, she ventures out into the night once again in search of the legendary medicine.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041102072917fw_/http://www.studio-ego.co.jp/030/ego/game/maw/mistie.html]Studio e.go![/url]]
